items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I met him in L.A. and took him around to a couple of clubs to set in, that was the first time I’d heard him.

ctx.x: And what’s it like playing with a violin? With Claude?

Oh I love it he plays great blues, actually plays good jazz. And we played together before — well we didn’t play together before, I met him in L.A. and took him around to a couple of clubs to set in, that was the first time I’d heard him. I didn’t know anything about him. But he’s remarkable. How old is he?
